page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    liked_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

liked_playlist_ids={p['playlist_id'] for p in liked_playlists}

# Fetch my playlist library playlists
library_playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    library_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

library_playlist_ids={p['playlist_id'] for p in library_playlists}

# Intersection of playlist IDs
intersect_playlist_ids = sorted(list(liked_playlist_ids.intersection(library_playlist_ids)))

print('library_playlists_count', len(library_playlists))

print('intersect_playlist_ids', intersect_playlist_ids)

# Union of song_ids from those intersect playlists
intersect_song_ids=set()
for p in liked_playlists:
    if p['playlist_id'] in liked_playlist_ids and p['playlist_id'] in library_playlist_ids:
        for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
            intersect_song_ids.add(sid)

candidate_song_ids = sorted(list(intersect_song_ids))
print('candidate_song_ids_count', len(candidate_song_ids))
print('candidate_song_ids', candidate_song_ids)

update_songs = sorted([sid for sid, st in song_review_state.items() if st['state']=='needs_update'])
no_review_songs = sorted([sid for sid, st in song_review_state.items() if st['state']=='no_review'])

update_results=[]
for sid in update_songs:
    rid = song_review_state[sid]['review_id']
    try:
        res = apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rid, access_token=spotify_token, rating=5)
        update_results.append((sid,rid,res))
        print('updated', sid, 'review_id', rid, '=>', res)
    except Exception as e:
        print('update failed', sid, rid, e)
        raise

create_results=[]
for sid in no_review_songs:
    try:
        res = apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token, rating=5)
        create_results.append((sid,res))
        print('rated', sid, '=>', res)
    except Exception as e:
        print('create failed', sid, e)
        raise

if not candidate_song_ids:

    liked_playlists=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)

            break
        liked_playlists.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    candidate_song_ids=sorted({sid for p in liked_playlists for sid in p.get('song_ids',[])})

print('verifying_count', len(candidate_song_ids))

bad=[]

        res=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=spotify_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, min_rating=1, max_rating=5)
